  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  patient_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'active', 'revoked', 'expired')),
  granted_scop
